rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-82.1/.description: Load limitation chart for the Rosemount 3051 4-20 mA HART output (output code A, p. 82): one straight boundary line of maximum loop resistance from 0 Ω at 10.5 Vdc to 1387 Ω at 42.4 Vdc, with the shaded operating region B below it.

rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-pdf-7.description: Step response diagram of the transmitter output after pressure is released (Dynamic performance, p. 79): output in % of total step change (100%, 36.8%, 0%) versus unscaled time, showing dead time Td, time constant Tc to the 36.8% point (63.2% of total step change) and response time = Td + Tc.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-pdf-7.use_for: Use it to find the definition of response time as dead time plus time constant; it gives no time values.
rosemount-3051-00813-0100-4001/fig-pdf-7.structure: x: time (no scale printed); y: transmitter output (% of total step change), 0% to 100%; series: transmitter output
